The last great civilization of magic. Bu: The last great civilization of magic. Built upon knowledge, stone, and the boundless power of the arcane.
Before the Fall, the archivists of Arora: Before the Fall, the archivists of Aroraium understood that the end was near. In those final days, they worked without sleep — sealing the Grand Libraries beneath seven layers of stone, protecting thousands of volumes against the coming darkness.
The archives contain over twelve million: The archives contain over twelve million manuscripts. Spells from every known school of magic. Histories of civilizations that predate Aroraium itself. Forbidden tomes that record rituals capable of reshaping the world.
For three centuries, these archives rema: For three centuries, these archives remained sealed. Today, their gates stand open once more.
Three centuries of silence. Now the arch: Three centuries of silence. Now the archives unlock. The Orders gather. And the relics of the greatest civilization await those with the courage — and the knowledge — to claim them.
Before the first kingdoms rose and befor: Before the first kingdoms rose and before the great empires carved their names into stone, there was Aroraium — the mightiest civilization the world had ever known.
Built across towering plateaus and spann: Built across towering plateaus and spanning vast river deltas, its architecture spoke in the language of gods. Marble columns the height of mountains supported palaces that held courts of a thousand scholars. Ancient academies shaped the minds of legendary mages whose names are still whispered in forgotten temples.
Aroraium did not conquer with armies. It: Aroraium did not conquer with armies. It conquered with knowledge — the most powerful force ever wielded by mortal hands.
After the Fall, five ancient orders pres: After the Fall, five ancient orders preserved Aroraium`s legacy. Each carries a different shard of its forgotten power.
No empire lasts forever — not even the g: No empire lasts forever — not even the greatest one. What shattered Aroraium was not an invading army, nor a plague, nor a famine. It was the pursuit of knowledge without limit.
In the Seventh Age, the Council of Archm: In the Seventh Age, the Council of Archmages attempted to breach the final seal — a boundary between the mortal world and the infinite arcane void. The ritual lasted forty days. On the forty-first, the sky broke.
The great academies crumbled. The librar: The great academies crumbled. The libraries were sealed beneath the earth. The five Orders scattered. And the civilization that had stood for four thousand years was swallowed by silence.
